title: RuntimeError: Intel XPU device doesn't support querying free memory on PyTorch 2.9+xpu (LN/L Arc 140V)
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Description:
I am experiencing an issue when trying to load models on an Intel GPU (LN/L Arc 140V) using PyTorch 2.9.0+xpu. Any attempt to load a model causes a RuntimeError related to torch.xpu.mem_get_info(). This prevents me from running even small models that should fit into GPU memory.

Steps to reproduce:
```python
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
import torch

print("Using device:", "xpu" if torch.xpu.is_available() else "cpu")

model_name = "./Qwen3-06B"  # path to local model

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    model_name,
    device_map="auto",  # tried also device_map="sequential"
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
```

Error message:

RuntimeError: The device (Intel(R) Graphics [0x64a0]) doesn't support querying the available free memory.
You can file an issue at https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues to help us prioritize its implementation.


Environment:

OS: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS (noble)

Python: 3.12

PyTorch: 2.9.0+xpu

Torchvision: 0.24.0+xpu

Torchaudio: 2.9.0+xpu

Intel PyTorch Extension: 2.8.10+xpu

Intel runtime packages:

dpcpp-cpp-rt==2025.2.1

impi-rt==2021.16.1

intel-cmplr-lib-rt==2025.2.1

intel-cmplr-lib-ur==2025.2.1

intel-cmplr-lic-rt==2025.2.1

intel-opencl-rt==2025.2.1

intel-openmp==2025.2.1

intel-pti==0.13.1

intel-sycl-rt==2025.2.1

oneccl==2021.16.1

oneccl-devel==2021.16.1

onemkl-sycl-*==2025.2.0

Additional context / notes:

The issue occurs when using device_map="auto" or when trying to load the model fully into GPU memory.

I have already tried setting the environment variable recommended for oneAPI 2025.1:

export UR_L0_ENABLE_SYSMAN_ENV_DEFAULT=0


but the problem persists.

The GPU memory query function works fine on CPUs and other device types.

I am running PyTorch 2.9 RC1 XPU build, which should theoretically have the latest Intel GPU support.

My Intel GPU is LN/L Arc 140V (16GB).

This problem seems to be related to how torch.xpu.mem_get_info() interacts with the Intel oneAPI runtime and the XPU device.

References:

[Intel PyTorch 2.8 XCCL announcement](https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/distributed.html#torch.distributed.distributed_c10d.is_xccl_available)

Similar reported issues: #159728, #161403

Expected behavior:
PyTorch should be able to query the available GPU memory on Intel Arc GPUs without raising an error, allowing models to be loaded fully into XPU memory.

### Versions
